Geometry_and_Silhouette: Small ceramic or glass cup, compact enough to fit in one palm, filled with dark liquid.
Cup is proportionally wider than it is tall, with a small capacity.
Liquid surface shows a thin layer of golden-brown crema foam.

Cup may have saucer with matching design.
Handle is small, sized for fingertip grip.
Material_and_Context: Ceramic cup (white, cream, or colored) with glossy glaze.
Liquid is dark brown to nearly black with golden crema.
Saucer may show coffee ring stains.

Drip tray (removable metal grate) at base.
